request_user:
Fact: additional_assets
What to find: Other assets released with the model (training data, training code, inference or evaluation code, checkpoints) and how to access them.
Card sections that often contain it: Model Sources, Resources, Links

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: A GitHub repository (github.com/ibm-granite/granite-4.2-language-models) lists the full training datasets. A custom granite_thinking_parser is included in the model repository for vLLM. Evaluations use a framework based on the NeMo Evaluator SDK (GitHub link). Base model Granite-4.1-8B-Base is on Hugging Face. A Granite 4.2 HF collection and technical blog are also linked.
quotes: A full listing of training datasets is available in the [Granite 4.2 GitHub repository](https://github.com/ibm-granite/granite-4.2-language-models).
Use the custom `granite_thinking_parser` included in this repository (requires vLLM v0.20+).
Evaluations are run with an evaluation framework based on NeMo [Evaluator SDK](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Evaluator).
